assessment.subject: Missing-element CollectionView handling
assessment.rationale: The new CollectionView path scrolls until the control is fully visible. isFullyVisible also requires existence, hittability, non-zero bounds, and full containment.

assessment.subject: App-scoped landscape capture
assessment.rationale: Each named coverage viewport now attaches XCUIScreen.main.screenshot(), which captures the device screen after orientation assertion and observed-settings validation.

assessment.subject: Preserved control checks
assessment.rationale: The action path still requires reachability, 44-point width, and 44-point height before its screenshot.

assessment.subject: Scope
assessment.rationale: The pinned diff changes one UI-test file only. It adds no app design, dependency, service, API, or coverage-matrix expansion.

verdict: PASS — no actionable specification-scope finding in the pinned source delta. This review does not establish pilot or final acceptance.
